cases.explain: «лесных деревьев» — after the preposition «среди», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

cases.explain: «левая рука» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

cases.explain: «молодой олень» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
